spec_match.rationale: Exercises the real mixed-content surfaces adjacent to Ask-before-HTTP: img auto-upgrade observed via the Resource Timing entry's URL, and active-content blocking observed as a real fetch() TypeError, with the page-scheme dependency stated up front.

interactive.rationale: Editable URL, four presets, and two attempt buttons that make real network requests and report real load/error/timing outcomes newest-first.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises real http/https subresource attempts with outcomes read from events and Resource Timing; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes upgraded vs loaded vs blocked, opaque no-cors responses, missing timing entries, invalid URLs, the no-http-fallback property of the image upgrade, and the non-https-page case where TypeError means network failure rather than mixed content.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5143933628841984 and MDN Mixed content.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers the secure-context contracts; subresource upgrade behaviour is scheme-dependent and asynchronous, so it is demonstrated interactively rather than asserted, which the suite's manual entries acknowledge.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Both device classes verified via CDP with autorun (same-origin fetch fulfilled, styles.css, elapsed reported; zero console errors). The auto-upgrade and mixed-content-blocked branches require the https deployment plus reachable external hosts — the sandbox proxy rewrites external TLS, so those branches were verified by code review and honest labelling only.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on every img and fetch attempt with outcome, scheme, and mixed-content classification; chooser-style noise avoided.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; result cards colour-code by border only with AA text; buttons override background and colour together.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled url input, preset group with role=group and aria-label, results list aria-live=polite with full-text outcomes, 44px controls.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP matrix clean at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow (result URLs wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere), controls wrap with gap.

openQuestions.title: Verify the auto-upgrade and blocked branches on the live https deployment
openQuestions.detail: On https://chrome-platform-showcase...deno.net the http-image preset should log 'AUTO-UPGRADED' with the https twin's timing entry, and the http fetch preset should reject as active mixed content. The sandbox cannot produce these outcomes (page is http://localhost and external TLS is intercepted), so a manual pass on production with DevTools open would close the loop.

openQuestions.title: Consider a same-origin server route for deterministic upgrade evidence
openQuestions.detail: An echo route in server.ts serving an image on both schemes would make the upgraded-vs-loaded distinction reproducible without third-party hosts, but the routine is fenced out of server.ts — queue as a manual task if placeholder hosts prove flaky.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap on control rows, gap over margins, overflow-wrap for long unbreakable strings (URLs).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap+gap; result cards use overflow-wrap:anywhere so long URLs never force page overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous result updates via a polite live region; keep full outcomes as text, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results ul is aria-live=polite with aria-label; every card carries a text tagline plus key/value lines; colour is a redundant channel.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button generated code snippet
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate visible labels with inputs via for/id; type=url conveys input mode.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The target field is a labelled type=url input with spellcheck off.

summary: Real-request lab for the subresource half of the HTTPS-by-default push. Same-origin and failure paths runtime-verified on both classes; the https-page-only branches are honestly labelled and left as a production manual check.
